data.title: Fahid Beach Residences
data.about:
Fahid Beach Residences by Aldar Properties is one of the first launches within the trio of planned districts on Fahid Island, a visionary master development in Abu Dhabi. This waterfront residential complex features 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, 1 to 2-bedroom townhouses and 5-bedroom penthouses. Designed by acclaimed architect Koichi Takada, each residence is thoughtfully crafted with Italian kitchens and wardrobes, motion sensor lighting, and a choice between two elegant design schemes, light or dark.

Residents of Fahid Beach Residences will enjoy a host of amenities such as a sports club, water sports hub, Coral Drive boutique retail strip, and more. With 15 km of footpaths, a 2 km waterfront promenade, a 1 km park, and vast open spaces, this development is ideal for those seeking lifestyle and investment value.

characteristics_module.title: The First Step into Fahid Island’s Future
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Waterfront Location: Offers a prime setting on Fahid Island, complete with a 2 km promenade.
  • Early Launch Advantage: Places you among the first to invest in one of Fahid Island’s pioneering districts.
  • World-Class Design: Created by a nature-inspired architect, Koichi Takada.
  • Luxury Amenities: Include podium-level wellness facilities, coworking spaces, and dedicated areas for children.
  • Spacious Layouts: Feature 1–5 bedroom units with expansive balconies and open-plan interiors.
  • Community Living: Enhanced with a school, clinic, and retail mall integrated within the island.
  • Trusted Developer: Backed by Aldar Properties, a recognized leader in the UAE real estate market.

location_tile.title: Abu Dhabi at Your Doorstep, the Beach in Your Backyard
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Fahid Beach Residences in Fahid Island enjoys a prime coastal location in Abu Dhabi, offering residents direct access to a 2 km waterfront promenade, lush green spaces, and shaded walkways. The location is designed for walkability and community living, with 15 km of interconnected footpaths, a 1 km park, and dedicated zones like Coral Drive and Palmerie for shopping, dining, and recreation.

  • 5 minutes to Yas Island
  • 15 minutes to Saadiyat Island
  • 20 minutes to Abu Dhabi International Airport
  • 15 minutes to Guggenheim Abu Dhabi
  • 15 minutes to Zayed National Museum
